text:
emma: hi all  wave - first week checklist: i can open Datadog dashboards but Grafana traces panels 403 and Sentry project shows "You don't have access". who should i ping for the obs setup?

access-bot: Welcome! To request access run `access request` or post here with your email.

raf: welcome emma! :tada: pinging @sre-ops. quick Q: did you accept the SSO invite email? sometimes the invite requires a browser restart.

emma: yep accepted at 10:02, re-logged, still 403. my email is emma.k@redwood.com.

sre-ops: adding emma.k@redwood.com to group `observability-readers` and Grafana ACL for folder `Observability/Traces`. also queued Datadog read role. should be live in ~2-3 mins.

emma: tried again and Grafana traces loads! thanks. suggestion: Dev docs still reference the old dashboard slug; can someone update the quickstart? i almost spent 20 mins digging.

raf: good catch. PRs welcome :grin:. short tip for others: for sharing into PRs use Grafana Panel -> Share -> Snapshot -> External link (no auth). iframe will 403 for external reviewers.

emma: noted. also, Sentry strips some fields in prod - how do i get full context for debugging?

sre-ops: security policy avoids full PII in prod. if you need expanded context open a temporary access request and tag `security` + owning team. they can provide a time-limited session or sanitized export.

emma: one last thing - keyboard shortcuts for Grafana? any favorites to move faster?

raf: `g` then `d` to go to dashboards, `/` to search, `t` for time picker, `s` to share panel. there's a help menu bottom-left too.

emma: perfect, thanks everyone. i'll add a tiny note to onboarding doc about the SSO cookie restart + snapshot vs iframe and send a PR.

access-bot: access updates: emma.k@redwood.com -> Grafana:viewer, Group:observability-readers, Datadog:read.

emma: confirmed all good. appreciate the help :raised_hands:
